Common.tagline: A little place for big conversations.

Landing.intro: Anyone can join with a verified email address. Your space starts private, even without friends. Connect only when you choose.

Auth.description: Sign in or create an account with your verified email. You can join without any invitation.
Auth.unavailable: Sign-in will be available once Clerk and Convex are configured.

Home.description: This is your private Sengapp lounge. Conversations and companions arrive in the next phases. Your profile is ready even with zero contacts. Visit Connections only when you would like to invite someone.

Connections.description: Your social circle is private. Invite someone to connect whenever you are ready. There is no public people directory.
Connections.noContacts: No connections yet — that is completely fine. Your personal profile works on its own.

Invites.askFriend: Ask a friend to share a connection invitation link with you. You can create your own Sengapp account without one.
Invites.signInFirst: Sign in or create a verified account first. The invitation will wait; opening it never automatically accepts it.
Invites.unavailableDetail: This link may have expired, been used, or may not be for your account. No connection was made.
Invites.acceptExplanation: Accepting connects your profiles. It does not share your private conversations, messages, or personal AI companion.
Invites.choiceError: Could not complete that choice. The invitation may no longer be available.
Invites.inviteDescription: Anyone can join Sengapp. This one-use link only requests a private connection; the other person chooses whether to accept.
Invites.emailRestriction: An invitation without an email restriction can be used by the first eligible person who accepts it.
Invites.notePlaceholder: It is me! Let us stay in touch.
Invites.privateLinkDescription: Shown only now. Treat this link as a secret until it expires or is used.
Invites.created: Connection invitation created. Copy or share the link.
Invites.createError: Could not create an invitation. Try again in a moment.
Invites.copied: Copied. You can now paste the invitation into your message.
Invites.copyManual: Automatic copy is unavailable. Select and copy the visible link manually.
Invites.shareUnavailable: Native sharing is not available. Use Copy link instead.
Invites.shareMessage: Would you like to connect with me on Sengapp?
Invites.shareClosed: Share dialog closed. Your link is still available here.
Invites.shareCanceled: Sharing canceled. Your link is still available to copy.
Invites.shareError: Sharing was not available. You can copy the link instead.
Invites.linkClosed: Invitation used or closed; its link is no longer active.

Access.backendHeading: Sengapp needs its Clerk and Convex connection
Access.backendDescription: Set up the development environment in docs/development.md to unlock sign-in and private connections.
Access.verifyFirst: Sign in with your verified account first.
Access.suspended: This account is suspended. Contact the Sengapp operator.
Access.verifyEmail: Verify your email address with Clerk and sign in again.
Access.setupFailed: We could not prepare your private space. Please try again.
Access.operatorRequired: This page requires an operator account.
Access.operatorQuestion: Designated operator? Initialize your verified operator account.
Access.operatorFailure: This account is not authorized as an operator.

Profile.title: Profile & privacy
Profile.identityDescription: Customize how friends and family see you in shared spaces.
Profile.statusPlaceholder: Listening to rainy lo-fi and roasting chestnuts…
Profile.reducedMotion: Prefer reduced motion (calm companion and interface animations)
Profile.handleHelp: Handle must be 3–24 characters using lowercase letters, numbers, or underscores.
Profile.accentHelp: Accent color must use a valid hex value.
Profile.presenceDescription: All signals are enabled by default for a warm shared space, and each can be toggled off independently at any time.
Profile.onlineDescription: Show when you are actively connected to Sengapp.
Profile.lastSeenDescription: Allow friends to see when you last visited the lounge.
Profile.readReceiptsDescription: Show when you have read messages in direct and group chats.
Profile.typingDescription: Display a live indicator when you are composing a reply.

Appearance.title: Appearance
Appearance.description: Make your own cozy space. Every choice stays private to your account.
Appearance.previewDescription: This is how Sengapp will feel. Nothing is saved until you choose Save.
Appearance.resetPreview: Defaults previewed. Save to keep them.

Operator.title: Operator tools
Operator.roles: Account roles are controlled by the verified server-side allowlist. Member signup never grants operator privileges.
Operator.invites: Connection invitations now belong to each member, not the operator.
